topics.name: screenshot
topics.title: Screenshot
topics.body:
# Screenshot

The screenshot plugin drives macOS's native Screenshot shortcuts through System Events. It does not use `screencapture`, ScreenCaptureKit, or any pixel-reading API inside Flash.

Commands:

- `:screenshot` or `:screenshot options` - open the Screenshot toolbar (`Cmd-Shift-5`)
- `:screenshot screen` - screen capture to file (`Cmd-Shift-3`)
- `:screenshot selection` - selected-region capture to file (`Cmd-Shift-4`)
- `:screenshot window` - window capture to file (`Cmd-Shift-4`, then `Space`)
- `:screenshot screen_clipboard` - screen capture to clipboard (`Cmd-Ctrl-Shift-3`)
- `:screenshot selection_clipboard` - selected-region capture to clipboard (`Cmd-Ctrl-Shift-4`)
- `:screenshot window_clipboard` - window capture to clipboard (`Cmd-Ctrl-Shift-4`, then `Space`)

Direct CLI verbs are also available: `flash screenshot_options`, `flash screenshot_screen`, `flash screenshot_selection`, `flash screenshot_window`, `flash screenshot_screen_clipboard`, `flash screenshot_selection_clipboard`, and `flash screenshot_window_clipboard`.

For mappings, use the stable plugin-command form, e.g. `["flash", "plugin_command", "--command=screenshot", "--subcommand=selection_clipboard"]`.
